$comment: Single token source for SMPT publications (decks, memos, report covers, social covers, exhibits). Values mirror the Architectural Research Studio site tokens in app/globals.css and the chart series set in components/markets/types.ts; tests/publication-tokens.test.ts fails when they drift. Hex values are written without '#' by the TS and Python loaders when a library needs it.

elevated.role: Table heads, selected rows, soft bands

plate.role: Exhibit and chart ground; text on graphite or malachite fills

graphite.role: Text, primary rules, primary marks, table-head fill

hematite.role: Declines, controls, ended or lapsed status

ochre.role: Designations and cautions; rules and markers only, never small text

neutrals.$comment: Graphite-tinted functional greys for non-focus series and comparison marks. Marks and fills only, never text: mid is at least 3:1 on plaster and plate. They are not brand colours.

sequentialRamp.$comment: Single-hue malachite ramp for ordered magnitude (heat grids, intensity). Light to dark; step 1 is nearly ground, step 5 equals the series malachite.
sequentialRamp.name: malachite

contrast.$comment: WCAG 2.x contrast ratios, computed from the hex values above. Ground = plate / plaster.
rules: Text uses graphite, slate or faint on plaster, plate, chalk or elevated (all at least 5.3:1 on plaster).
Light text (plate) sits only on graphite (16.4:1) or malachite (7.65:1) fills.
Ochre, lapis and series ochre are marks and rules, never small text; the dash pattern, not hue alone, identifies a series.
Hairlines are not text and carry no contrast requirement.

type.labels: Sentence case, medium weight, no tracked all-caps.
type.fallbackPolicy: No silent substitution. A missing Spectral or Archivo fails the build loudly; PowerPoint cannot embed fonts, so the PDF export is the canonical, font-embedded form.
